final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS inv, c.Country AS country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avgp FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Country), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avgp) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.inv, s1.country, s1.avgp, s1.avgp - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT country, AVG(d) AS ad FROM s3 GROUP BY country), s5 AS (SELECT s3.inv, s3.country, s3.avgp, s3.d, s3.d - s4.ad AS e, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s3.d - s4.ad DESC) AS rk FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.country = s4.country) SELECT inv, country, avgp, d, e FROM s5 WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY e DESC
